routes.evidence: Source route declaration only; actual authenticated reachability not exercised.

purpose: Review signed declarative analytics packs from a bundled catalog, manage device-local installation and explicit trust, preview synthetic sandbox results, inspect local audit history, import/export envelopes, and understand security limitations.
primaryGoal: Make an informed explicit install/grant decision without confusing signature validity, publisher recognition, user trust, synthetic preview, and real vehicle analytics.

dataSources.name: Catalog
dataSources.sourceOwner: Feature-local CATALOG_ENTRIES imported from lib\catalogFixtures.ts, annotated using repository.listInstalled().
dataSources.behavior: Catalog is bundled intentionally synthetic demonstration content, not invented runtime fleet data. Installed status is derived from local versions; unknown repository data currently maps to no installed version.
dataSources.limits: Catalog fixture module contents were not individually reviewed; no server route or network request is implied.

dataSources.name: Installed records
dataSources.sourceOwner: PackRepositoryProvider -> createPackRepository -> KvStore; IndexedDB database teslasync-intelligence-packs, store kv.
dataSources.behavior: queryKey intelPackQueryKeys.installed; staleTime=0; repository.listInstalled(); versions, enabled state, original verification and rollback snapshots remain local.

dataSources.name: Trust and mutations
dataSources.behavior: Install, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, enable/disable and trust decisions invalidate installed, audit and affected trust keys. Trust reads are enabled only for a truthy pack ID, staleTime=0. No actual action executed.

dataSources.name: Verification
dataSources.behavior: Local query keyed by digest or manifest/signature fallback; retry=false, staleTime=Infinity, enabled only with an envelope. Platform failures remain explicit.
dataSources.limits: Cryptographic implementation and browser support not validated; security text is a source-stated contract, not a penetration-test result.

dataSources.name: Sandbox
dataSources.sourceOwner: Memoized runSandboxPreview imported from lib\sandboxRunner.ts; bundled sample data.
dataSources.behavior: Synchronous bounded synthetic preview; installed grant is used when available, otherwise full requested capabilities are explicitly simulated. This is not a grant mutation or real telemetry access.
dataSources.limits: Interpreter implementation, ceilings enforcement and units of arbitrary manifest formula outputs were not validated.

dataSources.name: Audit
dataSources.behavior: Local newest-first events, capped by imported MAX_AUDIT_LOG_ENTRIES; table is read-only and paginated.

dataSources.name: File import/export and static methodology
dataSources.sourceOwner: FileReader, parseSignedEnvelope and browser Blob download; feature manifest/budget constants.
dataSources.behavior: File/paste import validates before opening the same detail/verification/confirmation flow; no direct installation. Export serializes the existing envelope as pretty JSON with sanitized filename. Methodology renders source-declared guarantees and non-guarantees.
dataSources.limits: Backend router inspection not applicable: inspected hooks do not use request(). No backend capability or runtime network isolation proof claimed.

components.contract: Retain shared page width/gutters, card hierarchy and source-state presentation; do not add another marketplace shell.
components.inspection: Consumer imports verified; shared implementations except explicitly listed Tabs/Toggle not inspected.

components.contract: Tabs takes tabs, activeTab, onChange, ariaLabel and optional idBase; caller owns linked tabpanel. Preserve six keys and default catalog. FadeIn keyed by activeTab preserves current conditional mounting.

owners: @/components/ui: Button, Toggle, Select, Input, Textarea, Modal, ConfirmDialog, CopyButton
components.contract: Existing loading/disabled, labeled fields, overlay focus and typed confirmation APIs remain canonical. No competing grant picker or confirmation system.
Stable table IDs intelligence-packs:installed and intelligence-packs:audit-log; value filters, expanded detail, audit pagination and mobile details must survive.

Retain sample/value accessible data columns, all declared widgets, formula unit text, budget/denied-field notices and sample-run provenance. Brief latency raw value is seconds (durationMs/1000), display remains source milliseconds.
Retain signed/unsigned/tampered distinctions, fingerprint grouping/copy/mismatch, compatibility reasons, capability descriptions and manual-only recommendations.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Publisher/capability/content headings and several sibling metadata blocks use repeated local typography classes; existing Text/Caption/Code/role wrappers already cover this need.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Adopt existing typography roles without replacing domain labels or adding a new composite.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Installed, audit and export already share one repository-state adapter; verification, capabilities, fingerprints and recommendations also have dedicated owners.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse these owners; no speculative shared marketplace components.

sourceStrategies: Tabs.tsx:91-94 uses max-w-full, overflow-x-auto and nonwrapping labels.
InstalledInventoryPanel.tsx:173 prioritizes name/enabled; AuditLogPanel.tsx:80 prioritizes timestamp/action.
ImportExportPanel.tsx:122-134 truncates pack name in a flex row; PublisherFingerprintDisplay.tsx:41-42 wraps fingerprint/copy/status.

issues.detail: Explicit mobile column subset omits verification and lifecycle actions; audit subset similarly omits pack/detail. Whether DataTable exposes omitted fields/actions through its current mobile detail strategy was not inspected or exercised.
issues.fix: Verify full details, rollback/uninstall, verification and audit context remain reachable at every specified width; use existing DataTable mobile/detail APIs rather than dropping data.

issues.detail: Detail footer uses a nonwrapping action row; long translations and nested confirmation replacement require narrow-width/open-state inspection. No clipping has been proved.
issues.fix: Test 320px and 200% text with long names/capabilities/translations; reflow within existing Modal/ConfirmDialog contracts if needed.

accessibility.status: source findings only; keyboard, screen-reader, focus, contrast and OS modes unverified
positiveEvidence: Tabs.tsx:70-87 provides Left/Right and Home/End navigation; labels and focus styles are present.
CapabilityRequestList.tsx:36-39 uses Granted/Denied text, not only color.
SandboxPreviewPanel.tsx:63-72 supplies chart ariaLabel and sample/value data columns.
ImportExportPanel.tsx:81 names the file input and uses a shared Button to activate it.
PublisherFingerprintDisplay.tsx:43 names the fingerprint copy action.

issues.detail: Tabs emits aria-controls to generated panel IDs (Tabs.tsx:112), but this consumer supplies no idBase and the following FadeIn/LayoutCard has no matching id, role=tabpanel or aria-labelledby. The accessible tab-to-panel relationship is absent in inspected consumer source.
issues.fix: Pass a stable idBase and mark the active panel with the matching id, role and tab label association, preserving six keys and conditional mounts.

issues.detail: Unavailable/pending enable switch is visually suppressed with opacity/pointer-events, but disabled is not passed to Toggle. Toggle supports native disabled; the guard prevents mutation but does not communicate disabled semantics to keyboard/assistive technology.
issues.fix: Use existing disabled={!interactive} plus truthful loading/unresolved/blocked explanation; preserve isEnableAllowed and the guarded callback.

issues.detail: The page requests size=sm, whose button track is h-5 w-9. No 44px hit area is visible in this implementation. Actual target spacing and applicability of WCAG exceptions remain unmeasured.
issues.fix: Shared owner should evaluate target reachability while preserving compact track visuals, existing sizing and switch semantics; do not add a page-local switch.

present: PackRepositorySource.tsx:16-35 separates unresolved/loading/fatal/retained/ready and offers retry; Installed/Audit/Export use it.
VerificationStatusBadge.tsx:29-53 separates checking, browser limitation, failure and unknown; subsequent switch distinguishes each verification status.
CatalogPanel.tsx:29, InstalledInventoryPanel.tsx:154, AuditLogPanel.tsx:68 and ImportExportPanel.tsx:117 retain domain empty states.
ImportExportPanel.tsx:104-113 shows up to ten parse errors; file read failures have explicit error copy.
SandboxPreviewPanel.tsx:113-159 retains missing formula, no rows, latest/average unknown, budget error and denied-field messages.
SandboxRunBrief.tsx:22,59-75 distinguishes budget-limited outputs from complete sample evaluation, never live-data freshness.

issues.detail: Missing installed query data becomes an empty map and installedVersion=null; only isLoading is returned and CatalogPanel/SandboxPreviewPanel ignore it. A pending/failed local inventory can look like not installed despite the bundled catalog itself being available.
issues.fix: Keep bundled catalog visible, but expose repository trust state separately and label installed status unresolved/failed rather than inferring absence; retain installed data on refresh failure.

issues.detail: Pending/error trust reads become an empty grant and none recorded; enable cell likewise treats unresolved trust as no trust. Unknown grant availability is not the same as explicit denied capability.
issues.fix: Render independent trust loading/error/retained states using existing source-state conventions; never loosen enable gating or fabricate approved capabilities.

issues.detail: Install/trust/block mutations await promises but no inline mutation error/recovery is rendered. Inventory rollback/uninstall/enable mutations similarly expose pending state without local error feedback. Persistence failure handling is not demonstrated.
issues.fix: Present independent mutation failure feedback and safe retry without auto-confirmation, capability changes or loss of retained records. Preserve trust-write-before-install ordering and acknowledged nontransactional behavior.

issues.detail: Retained state is passed but refreshError/paused reason is not supplied as visible retained feedback. Shared SourceContent behavior was not reviewed; distinct error/offline explanation cannot be certified.
issues.fix: Integration owner should inspect current SourceContent contract and exercise retained read failures before extending anything. Keep usable neighboring content and do not describe this local repository as a server outage.

states.offline: Local-first source does not need server availability; browser storage/crypto capability can still fail. No actual offline execution or fallback persistence test performed.

visualIssues.detail: Formula charts hardcode saturated cyan #22d3ee, green #34d399 with fill #34d39933 (line 93), and purple #a78bfa (line 101), bypassing the current shared chart palette/theme preferences.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing chart palette/token contract with restrained defaults; preserve all series, kinds, units, data tables, sample indexing and explicitly saved chart preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Inherited switch focus ring and active track use fixed cyan-500/cyan-600 rather than semantic focus/active tokens (line 113). This is a saturated accent source, not proof of excessive rendered brightness.
visualIssues.fix: Existing Toggle owner should align active/focus styling with canonical tokens while retaining state distinction, forced colors, density and saved theme choices.

visualIssues.detail: Raw spans/p paragraphs use ad-hoc text-xs/text-sm metadata roles across Audit, Installed, Catalog intro, detail, compatibility and fingerprint surfaces. These often already use theme variables, so the finding is typography inconsistency, not pure-white text.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Text/Caption/Code wrappers with semantic as overrides; preserve mono fingerprints, tabular numerals, wrap/truncation and all labels.

architectureIssues.detail: Page comment mentions only IndexedDB/localStorage, while packRepositoryContext.tsx:34-38 and kvStore.ts:145-152 also permit memory. Provider exposes backend but inspected panels do not consume it; memory-only durability is not visibly disclosed in these consumers.
architectureIssues.fix: Report the existing provider.backend through a local explanatory notice; document memory fallback accurately. Do not invent transactional or durable guarantees or replace storage architecture.

architectureIssues.detail: localStorage write exceptions are swallowed; IndexedDB selection is existence-based and does not transparently switch after an open failure. Existing source comments about fallback are not runtime durability evidence.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current persistence semantics in presentation work and disclose evidence limits. Any reliability contract change needs a separately scoped integration owner and focused persistence tests.

actions: Switch all six tabs; initial tab=catalog; selected tab conditionally mounts its panel.
Open/close detail, copy recomputed fingerprint, inspect publisher recognition and mismatch.
Signed valid install/upgrade requires explicit warning confirmation; failed verification remains blocked; unknown verification has no install button.
Unsigned local-development trust requires literal TRUST UNSIGNED; do not translate, bypass or prefill it.
Record blocked decision with empty approvedCapabilities; do not turn blocked state into an install path.
After confirmation record trust first, grant exactly manifest.capabilities, then install enabled=true or upgrade; no per-capability picker exists and none is authorized by this audit.
Enable/disable only with isEnableAllowed and pending guard; rollback to latest superseded version; uninstall only after explicit danger confirmation.
Choose any catalog pack for synthetic preview, including unsigned/tampered demonstrations; this does not install or grant real-data permissions.
Parse uploaded/pasted envelope, inspect errors, then review in detail; export installed envelope unchanged as JSON.
Filter/expand installed table; filter/paginate audit table; preserve stable table IDs and current DataTable-provided functionality.
dataBehavior: No backend endpoint is used by the inspected feature hooks; no server, auth, subscription or live-telemetry capability is inferred.
Repository provider owns one local instance for all tabs; DB/store names, query keys and fallback selection remain unchanged.
Install records retain original verification and timestamps; upgrade preserves enabled/installedAt and caps previousVersions at five (packRepository.ts:44; packActions.ts:69-99).
Rollback pops latest retained snapshot, discards rolled-back-from version and preserves current enabled state (packActions.ts:114-138).
Uninstall removes installed/history record but repository.removeInstalled does not remove the separate trust table (packRepository.ts:127-132); do not invent trust deletion.
Trust/installed/audit blobs are independently queued, not cross-table transactions. No modernization may claim atomic consent+install persistence.
Verification result, known publisher and user trust remain separate. Compatibility is shown as informational evidence; existing installability branches only on verification status.
Synthetic denied-field evaluation as zero is existing interpreter-facing behavior disclosed by the widget text, not permission to zero-fill unknown real data.
Preview fallback grant simulation is clearly described; current formula outputs and manifest units remain unchanged rather than guessed/converter-adjusted.
Brief source run duration converts milliseconds to raw latency seconds only for shared display, with preserved source-ms formatter and synthetic provenance.
preservation.modernizationRule: Preserve every listed section/action/data behavior; evaluate page plus extracted components rather than shrinking this 84-line orchestrator as a proxy for capability removal.
